title: Giraffe eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky-free, transparent background; giraffe in bright warm colors on dark screen -->
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#F5B942'/>
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='64' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#C97A2B'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#C97A2B'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='62' rx='3.5' ry='3' fill='#C97A2B'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='75' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#C97A2B'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='78' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#E8A93A'/>
  <rect x='40' y='80' width='6' height='15' rx='3' fill='#F5B942'/>
  <rect x='52' y='80' width='6' height='15' rx='3' fill='#E8A93A'/>
  <rect x='60' y='78' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#F5B942'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='29' y='91' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7A4A1E'/>
  <rect x='39' y='92' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7A4A1E'/>
  <rect x='51' y='92' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7A4A1E'/>
  <rect x='59' y='91' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7A4A1E'/>
  <!-- neck going up-left to head -->
  <path d='M60 62 Q68 40 64 24 L74 22 Q78 42 70 64 Z' fill='#F5B942'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='67' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#C97A2B'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='38' r='3' fill='#C97A2B'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='28' r='2.5' fill='#C97A2B'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='20' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#F5B942'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='22' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#E8A93A'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M72 16 Q78 18 74 24 Q80 26 74 30 Q78 33 72 36' stroke='#C97A2B' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <rect x='64' y='11' width='2.5' height='6' rx='1.2' fill='#7A4A1E'/>
  <rect x='69' y='11' width='2.5' height='6' rx='1.2' fill='#7A4A1E'/>
  <circle cx='65.2' cy='11' r='2' fill='#C97A2B'/>
  <circle cx='70.2' cy='11' r='2' fill='#C97A2B'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='18' r='2' fill='#3A2410'/>
  <circle cx='66.7' cy='17.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFF6D8'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='22' r='1' fill='#7A4A1E'/>
  <!-- snack: a leaf on a branch the giraffe eats -->
  <path d='M50 14 Q44 8 50 4 Q56 8 50 14 Z' fill='#5FBF4A'/>
  <path d='M50 14 Q52 10 58 6 Q58 12 50 14 Z' fill='#3E9E33'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='14' x2='53' y2='18' stroke='#7A4A1E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='23' r='1.8' fill='#F08080' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
